== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Deploy changes 1 to 3. The C-3PO battle clause loses its restriction to battles at a site. Own destiny cancellation protection is deleted. Opponent's Used Pile block under 13 cards becomes explicit for those cards in hand. Starfighter boosts and forfeit 4 agree.
